user.title: vidda_fish TV connection
user.description:
vidda_fish - local MQTT control for Hisense VIDDA TVs.
Target device: Vidda 85V7N Ultra
Author: x9fish (x9fish@gmail.com)
GitHub: https://github.com/x9fish/vidda_fish

Enter TV MQTT details. TV client ID is a 32-char hex string, e.g. 58CB91A51E6D4C8EAF618A084761838A.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to TV. Check IP and port.
error.tv_client_id_invalid: TV client ID must be a 32-character hex string
